title: AIFunctionFactory for Structured Tools
description: Create strongly-typed tool definitions with JsonSchema generation using AIFunctionFactory in Microsoft.Extensions.AI.

blocks.text: AIFunctionFactory is the modern way to create strongly-typed AI tools in Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It generates JsonSchema from method signatures automatically, eliminating the need to manually define input schemas or inherit from base classes.

blocks.title: Benefits
items: JsonSchema is generated automatically from method parameters.
Works with any delegate or static method.
Supports cancellation tokens, optional parameters, and default values.

blocks.title: AIFunctionFactory for order tools
blocks.content: Create strongly-typed tools with automatic JsonSchema generation.

blocks.title: Prefer AIFunctionFactory over AIFunction subclasses
blocks.text: AIFunctionFactory removes boilerplate and ensures your tool schema matches your method signature. Use it for new tools; migrate existing AIFunction subclasses when practical.

items.text: I can create an AIFunction from a method
I can pass AIFunction tools to IChatClient
I can inspect the generated JsonSchema

blocks.title: Lesson Summary
points: AIFunctionFactory creates strongly-typed tools with automatic JsonSchema.
No base class inheritance or manual schema definitions needed.
Generated schemas match method signatures exactly.
blocks.takeaway: Use AIFunctionFactory for new .NET AI tools to reduce boilerplate and prevent schema drift.
